scope: Read-only source and existing journal inspection; not a causal diagnostic or total physical-memory comparison.
source_observations: SchedulingMemoryFloor is upstream-default enabled unless VMLX_SCHEDULING_FLOOR=0, with4GiB headroom and a native startup-ceiling bound.
The new decode loop calls observe each step; prefill progress also calls it. GPU.deviceInfo is cached once per process.
The new loop catches MLX errors per iterator step via withError. The old loop lacks that scoped call; do not disable error capture to make timings look better.
Mei runtime policy docs already distinguish requested allocator values from live settings and state backend policies may adjust them. No explicit-policy API defect established.
bounds: Recorded candidate allocator peaks plus4GiB exceed its recorded startup limit, so these peaks cannot rule out later floor raises. The requests journal records allocator peak, not live memory limit or total process footprint.
